sources.title: 韩国岭南古文献中心《大山日記》现存12册678面馆目及1739第一册「湖上雜錄」封面影像
sources.quality_notes: First-party unified identifier KSAC+K05+KSM-WM.1739.4717-20130630.000310200011, 12 manuscript volumes/678 sides, formerly Andong clan, currently Korean Studies Institute. Institution describes first 1739 volume as 湖上雜錄, cover photographed at https://yn.ugyo.net/data/des/KSAC%2BK05%2BKSM-WM.1739.4717-20130630.000310200011/IMG/KSAC%2BK05%2BKSM-WM.1739.4717-20130630.000310200011-IMG.001_001.JPG. This is a cover, NOT original natal grid pp40-41. No source-file SHA or complete 1739 leaves authenticated this session. Physical-copy handwriting date of each embedded guest grid unknown. This catalog is the holding behind scholarly reproduction, not an independent ancient mechanical formula witness.

sources.title: Maristella Spur 2026《Interwoven Thoughts》p63-64图3a：李象靖个人册历中三张命盘之两张照片
sources.provider: De Gruyter Brill / Korean Studies Institute (reproduced manuscript image)
sources.quality_notes: Published chapter DOI10.1515/9783111682990-003, pp47-72, text pp63-64, Fig3a printed p64 visibly reproduces 2 of 3 12-cell square layouts; article locates all 3 at Hosang Chapjŏ pp40-41, birthday 辛卯正月二十九日 (1711/1771 cycles), cautiously says they 'seem' to use chamidusu. Original pp40-41 image file and third chart not individually hashed or rechecked against museum catalog UCI; chart inscription year is NOT fixed by calendar support year. Article footnote relies on existing 2018 Kim Ch'i scholarship; no proof of that transmission. Scholar says Hosang Chapjŏ while institutional first volume title appears 湖上雜錄; no exact physical folio/cross-title binding. Physical original glyph authority false, do not classify figures as separately authenticated old editions or proof of method identity.
